title: local_model_substrate
goal: turn local model selection into a typed lifecycle substrate for MLX and other local backends while preserving XSHELF adapter boundaries
constraints: preserve existing CX_MLX_MODEL and llm use mlx <model> compatibility
do not claim persisted KV restore unless a selected backend exposes evidence
keep TurboQuant cache and memory metrics typed
avoid hidden downloads or slow disk scans during normal execution

slices.goal: add a local model registry with deterministic list/add/remove behavior
allow llm use and task model overrides to resolve registry aliases while direct model strings remain compatible
add inspect and cheap accounting for local model path, size, cache location, and unresolved states
surface typed runtime capabilities for process, HTTP, resident-server, cache, batching, VLM, embedding, and reranker support
add registry-aware MLX smoke and optional benchmark profiles with typed runtime and cache metrics
support optional OpenAI-compatible resident local MLX servers through explicit HTTP adapter configuration
